title: Stalled Withdrawals, Millions Stolen: Inside India’s Crypto Exchange Troubles
summary: India’s cryptocurrency exchanges are facing turbulence on multiple fronts, with banking disruptions, regulatory scrutiny, and cybersecurity incidents exposing vulnerabilities across…
llm_summary: India’s crypto exchanges are currently hit by a perfect storm: banks are cutting off their accounts, regulators are tightening oversight, and several platforms have suffered major security breaches that left millions of dollars missing. These combined pressures have frozen withdrawals and exposed how fragile the country’s digital‑asset infrastructure remains, prompting calls for stricter compliance and stronger cyber‑defence measures.
